title: Lightly Crispy Korean Bok Choi Namul
description: A funky and crispy Korean dish featuring bok choi, perfect for a sick day, with a low sodium content and a unique flavor from kombu cold extract.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bok choi to the skillet and cook until it starts to wilt.
Add the kombu cold extract, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue to cook the bok choi until it is lightly crispy.
Season the bok choi with salt and sesame seeds.
Serve the bok choi hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
Let the dish cool slightly before serving.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
Reheat the leftovers in a skillet over low heat before serving.
